methodology.ranking: Cross-sectional ensemble of P(Top3), P(Top5), P(Top10), P(net-positive), P(large-loss), and robust expected-return regression.
methodology.parameterSelection: Recipe and basket size selected only from development walk-forward sessions.
methodology.holdout: Final 20 sessions frozen; no refit on holdout labels.
methodology.fairAlphaComparison: Selection alpha is measured exactly like V16 research: next-session close-to-close equal-weight return minus 0.60% cost.
methodology.executionLayer: Entry/stop/target and quality gates are reported separately and do not zero-out alpha backtest returns.

championReference.v17ProductionReference: V17 governance still references V16_9_EQUAL_WEIGHT_BASKET as champion.

promotion.reason: Separate V19 v2 challenger gate decides evidence status; explicit review remains mandatory.
